notes.subject: ממשך ומורט
notes.rationale: 'tall and smooth(-skinned)' (JPS/ASV of Cush) vs KJV 'scattered and peeled' — root משך draw out, מרט polish/pluck.

notes.subject: קו קו
notes.rationale: repeated קו: 'meted out by line' (KJV 'meted out and trodden down') vs some read 'sturdy/strong' — kept literal 'skelim wantaim ro, ro'.

notes.subject: בזאו
notes.rationale: rare verb: 'rivers have spoiled' (KJV) vs 'rivers divide' (ASV/JPS); rendered 'i bagarapim'.

notes.subject: קו קו
notes.rationale: doubled identical words, echo of measuring-line repetition; kept as repeated 'ro, ro'.

notes.subject: קו קו
notes.rationale: image of a nation measured out with a measuring line, parallel to line-of-line.

translation: Long dispela taim, ol bai bringim presen i kam long Yahwe Tsebaot, long wanpela lain man ol i girap longpela na skin i smusmu — i kam long lain man ol man i scare long em, bilong em i stat i kam inap nau — wanpela nasyon ol i skelim wantaim ro, ro, na ol i pundaun long sahet, we olgeta wara i bagarapim graun bilong en; i go long ples bilong nem bilong Yahwe Tsebaot, maunten Sion.

i stat i kam inap nau
